description: This PHP class defines a custom ImageRenderer for Markdown content within the Confluence format, handling rendering of images, especially external images, in a specific way.

classes.name: ImageRenderer
classes.description: Custom image renderer for Markdown images in Confluence format, handling external images differently.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of ImageRenderer, setting up the parent renderer.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders an image node; for external images (URLs starting with 'http'), creates a specific HTML structure, otherwise delegates to the parent renderer.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the configuration for the renderer, propagating to the parent renderer.
